annotations.text:
The hard part isn't drawing a tree — it's that 44 people don't fit.

Gen 2 alone is 15 people. At a legible chip size that's ~1,600px, so sibling branches collapse behind a switch and the direct line stays whole.

Three views, one primitive.

Start at the couple unit (bottom left) — everything else is that, nested, or that with a part missing.

Open question: does the wide overview earn its place at all, or is focused + narrow the whole product?

The overview is the only one needing horizontal scroll.

Read the notation board before building any of this.

Two standard conventions need data the model doesn't hold — sex, and birth dates. Adopting the form without them produces a chart that reads as authoritative and misleads.
